en: Between 1908 and 1924, Gwendoline and Margaret Davies amassed one of the largest collections of late-nineteenth and early-twentieth-century French paintings in Britain.
uz: 1908-yildan 1924-yilgacha Gvendolin va Margaret Deyvis Britaniyadagi XIX asr oxiri va XX asr boshlariga oid frantsuz rasmlarining eng yirik to'plamlaridan birini yig'ishdi.

en: Their religious upbringing in rural Wales gave them a deep sense of social responsibility and they chose to use their inheritance for cultural and philanthropic purposes.
uz: Uels qishloqlarida diniy tarbiya olganliklari ularga chuqur ijtimoiy mas'uliyat tuyg'usini berdi va ular o'z merosini madaniy hamda xayriya maqsadlarida ishlatishni tanladilar.

en: While it was long assumed that these men were largely responsible for the nature of the sisters' collection, it has recently been accepted that Gwendoline and Margaret retained a far more active role in the process.
uz: Uzoq vaqt davomida bu erkaklar opa-singillar to'plamining mohiyati uchun asosan javobgar deb hisoblab kelingan bo'lsa-da, yaqinda Gvendolin va Margaret bu jarayonda ancha faolroq rol o'ynaganligi e'tirof etildi.

en: Quite simply, high quality Old Master works were, if not beyond their means, then beyond what they were willing to pay for them.
uz: Oddiy qilib aytganda, yuqori sifatli “Eski ustalar” asarlari ularning imkoniyatidan tashqarida bo'lmasa ham, ular to'lashga tayyor bo'lgan narxdan qimmatroq edi.

en: However, it was only a few years before their collecting took a new direction and they turned to the work of the French Impressionists.
uz: Biroq, bir necha yil o'tar-o'tmas ularning to'plash faoliyati yangi yo'nalish oldi va ular frantsuz impressionistlari ijodiga yuzlandilar.

en: Their initial response to the war effort was to finance the safe passage of artists from occupied Belgium to Wales, as a humanitarian act, but also with the hope of establishing a vibrant artists' community in the area.
uz: Urushga bo'lgan dastlabki munosabatlari — insonparvarlik ishi sifatida, shuningdek hududda jonli rassomlar jamoasini barpo etish umidida — bosib olingan Belgiyadan Uelsga rassomlarning xavfsiz ko'chib o'tishini moliyalashtirish bo'ldi.

en: It was tedious and distressing work, which would have a permanent effect on Gwendoline's health.
uz: Bu zerikarli va iztirobli ish bo'lib, keyinchalik Gvendolinning sog'lig'iga doimiy ta'sir ko'rsatgan.

en: Yet they didn't feel obliged to follow fashionable tastes and were free to pursue their own preferences.
uz: Shunga qaramay, ular urfdagi didlarga ergashishga o'zlarini majbur his qilishmadi va o'z xohishlariga amal qilishda erkin edilar.

en: By the early 1920s, Gwendoline felt increasingly uncomfortable buying art works when faced with the poverty and social upheaval created by the First World War.
uz: 1920-yillarning boshlariga kelib, Birinchi jahon urushi keltirib chiqargan qashshoqlik va ijtimoiy larzalar oldida Gvendolin san'at asarlarini sotib olishdan tobora noqulaylik his qila boshladi.

en: The sisters collected French Impressionist paintings at a time when such art was routinely ignored by individuals and institutions alike.
uz: Opa-singillar frantsuz impressionizmi rasmlarini bunday san'at ham oddiy odamlar, ham muassasalar tomonidan odatda e'tiborsiz qoldirilgan bir paytda yig'ishdi.

en: There are usually about eight people but no more than ten, and everyone's always very friendly.
uz: Odatda sakkizga yaqin, lekin o'ndan ko'p bo'lmagan odam bo'ladi va hamma doim juda samimiy.

en: You learn about things like the weather, which is obviously really important.
uz: Siz ob-havo kabi narsalarni o'rganasiz, bu esa, shubhasiz, juda muhim.
